items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: Steve Brown, who I think is the greatest white bass player I've ever heard in my life.

ctx.x: One thing I plan to ask you, if there's anything you can tell us about Tom Brown, since we never got to talk to him, or any of our Tulane tapes. I know you played with him, recorded with him a lot. Any remarks about him?

Yeah, well, Tom Brown, uh, was a very interesting person to watch. He was different from anybody, and he could, uh, he could analyze what you were talking about immediately, and he had a hair, uh, trigger temper, you know? Yeah. If he didn't like it, boy, you were gonna get it right away. That's right. And, uh, he was very different from Steve. Steve Brown, who I think is the greatest white bass player I've ever heard in my life. Oh, just out of the world, that marvelous bass player. Too bad those kind of people,…
